userStories.title: Cheapest slots window (tracer bullet)
userStories.description: Addon skeleton end to end: .toc, Locales, Core ranking on vendor prices, Game adapter reading the bags, skinned window listing the three cheapest slots (icon, link, count, value), `/junkaway` and `/ja` toggle it, clicking a row picks the item up. Unit tests and smoke test in place.
acceptanceCriteria: Ranking returns slots ordered by value (vendor price x count), cheapest first, top 3, stable on ties
Empty slots are counted as free and never candidates
`/ja` opens the window with the three cheapest slots; empty-state text when nothing qualifies
Row click calls the container pick-up for that bag/slot; hovering a row shows the item tooltip
Window is skinned, movable, remembers its position, closes with Escape
`luajit tests/run.lua` and `luajit tests/smoke_test.lua` pass

userStories.title: Auction prices from Auctionator
userStories.description: Unit value becomes the higher of vendor price and Auctionator's auction price minus 5%; soulbound items keep vendor price only. Without Auctionator, vendor price alone (ADR 0003).
acceptanceCriteria: Unit value = max(vendor, floor(auction x 0.95)) for unbound items
Bound items ignore the auction price
Adapter uses Auctionator's API only when it is loaded (OptionalDeps)
Tests cover: auction beats vendor, vendor beats auction, bound, no Auctionator

userStories.title: Never-suggested rules
userStories.description: Slots without any price, quest items and items at or above the quality limit (setting, default Epic) are never suggested (ADR 0004). Locked slots are skipped too.
acceptanceCriteria: Unpriced items are excluded, not valued at 0
Quest class (12) excluded even with a vendor price
Quality >= limit excluded; limit stored in settings and normalized
Tests cover each rule

userStories.title: Ignore list
userStories.description: Each row has an Ignore button; ignored item IDs (account-wide) never come up. The window has an Ignored mode listing them with Remove buttons. `/ja ignore <link>` and `/ja unignore <link>`.
acceptanceCriteria: Ignore button removes all stacks of that item ID from the suggestions immediately
Ignored mode lists ignored items by name with Remove
Slash ignore/unignore accept item links and IDs
Ignore list stored in the account-wide saved variables
Unit tests for IgnoreList and ranking exclusion; smoke test clicks Ignore

userStories.title: Auto-open when bags become full
userStories.description: Watch bag changes; when the ordinary bags go from not full to full (free ordinary slots <= warnAt, default 0) the window opens once; when they are no longer full an auto-opened window closes. Special bags don't count and their items are never candidates. In combat, opening waits for combat to end (ADR 0005).
acceptanceCriteria: Special-bag slots (family ~= 0) excluded from free count and candidates
Window opens on the not-full -> full transition only
Auto-opened window closes when a slot frees up
warnAt setting normalized (0-5)
In combat the open is deferred to PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED
Tests for full/warnAt/special bags; smoke test fires BAG_UPDATE_DELAYED

userStories.title: Stack mark and merge suggestion
userStories.description: Stackable candidates get their own colour/mark (ADR 0001). When two partial stacks of the same item exist in ordinary bags, a merge row appears above the candidates with a Merge button that moves the smaller stack onto the larger (ADR 0002).
acceptanceCriteria: Candidates carry `stackable` (max stack > 1) and the row shows the stack mark
Merge detection: same item ID, both below max stack, ordinary bags, not locked; smaller onto larger
Merge row label 'Merge <name> (a + b)' and a Merge button doing pick-up + drop
Tests for merge detection and label

userStories.title: Settings panel and debug report
userStories.description: A settings page in the AddOns options with the quality limit and warn-at threshold, and `/ja debug` writing slot facts and the ranking into saved variables for reading after /reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings panel registered with the game's Settings UI; `/ja options` opens it
Changing a setting re-ranks immediately
`/ja debug` stores a report in JunkAwayDB
Smoke test opens the panel and runs debug

userStories.title: In-game verification
userStories.description: The user tries JunkAway in the client: window look, auto-open on full, pick-up from a row, merge button, Ignore, settings. Findings are fixed or recorded in the skill's api-notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Pick-up from a row works in the live client
Merge works in the live client
Auto-open on full seen
Classic skin approved
api-notes updated with what was verified
